metas.name: Witch on the Holy Night
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Drama, Fantasy Tags:Magic/Urban Fantasy/Witch/Urban/Female Protagonist/Kuudere/Fairy Tale/School/Ensemble Cast/Philosophy/Male Protagonist/Robots/Werewolf Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl’s story — the tale of a Witch.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Psychological, Romance, Supernatural Tags:Male Protagonist/Urban Fantasy/Urban/Female Protagonist/Coming of Age/Heterosexual/Primarily Adult Cast/College "Actually, I’m Touko Kirishima."

The audience erupted in excitement upon learning that the true identity of the mysterious, wildly popular internet singer was none other than the nation’s favorite actress, Mai Sakurajima. The scene was exactly the same as the dream Sakuta Azusagawa had seen on Christmas Eve.

Starting with Mai’s shocking confession on April 1, the impossible events that everyone once dreamed of keep happening one after another. The social media hashtag "#Yumemiru," where dreams come true, has vanished, and as Sakuta struggles with the disconnect between the reality before him and his own perception, he receives a message from a version of himself in an alternate reality.

―Stop Touko Kirishima,
―Before reality is rewritten.

To restore the world to its original state, Sakuta sets out to find Touko Kirishima. This is a story about overcoming the "Adolescent Syndrome".

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)

metas.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure
metas.description:
Genres: Drama, Mystery Tags:Medicine/Female Protagonist/Historical/Politics/Seinen/Ancient China The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

The emperor gives Jinshi an order. He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they’re in pristine condition. She’s beautiful, as if she were still alive. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan.

They arrive at a bustling city on the water. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away.

“I hope nothing happens...”

Jinshi’s premonition comes true. On the day of the concubine’s funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

metas.name: GROTESQQQUE
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Comedy, Drama, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Supernatural Tags:Aliens/Anthology/Vampire/Found Family/Gyaru/Monster Girl/Video Games/Virtual World/Battle Royale/Cohabitation/Post-Apocalyptic/Survival/Yuri/LGBTQ+ Themes/Cute Girls Doing Cute Things/Motorcycles/Kemonomimi Anthology movie consisting of three original animation segments:

Q1 - ÆLIENS (エリィアンズ)
Earth has entered an era of intergalatic exchange.
Amidst swirling prejudice and fear of aliens, Elie, an alien girl, arrives as a space goodwill ambassador. She loves Earth's culture and its often absurd daily life, and has teamed up with a civil servant working at the space agency to search for "friends".

Q2 - Yoroshiku★Shoujo (夜露死駆★少女)
GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes.
Night after night, girls who have lost their place in reality, known as "Gal P", gather here. Their goal is to become the winner, the "Queen" in a game called "Queen of Butterfly" or "QoB" for short.

Q3 - Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni (ノクターン～このグロテスクな夜に～)
A world after humanity has perished.
Traveling in a van are Ayame, a pure-blooded vampire, and three girls who survived by being bitten and "infected" by her. There, they find a sky full of stars that illuminate the night as brightly as day, and fields of glittering golden grass—even a desolate world looks so beautiful through the eyes of a vampire.
They enjoy a simple everyday life in this world left behind.

(Souce: Official Website, translated)

metas.name: To You in the Beyond
metas.description:
Genres: Mystery, Romance Tags:Classical Music/Coastal/Rural The story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

metas.description:
Genres: Mecha, Sci-Fi Tags:Real Robot The story of Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe is set during the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy.
